items.a: It is an invite-only beta for now: ask an admin for an invite code and create your account on the register page.
New accounts get free credits; each generation consumes credits, and your balance and history are always visible in the studio.
Three kinds today: lifestyle scenes, marketing posters, and product shots. Long detail pages ship as posters.

items.q: Will poster text come out wrong?
items.a: Posters are rendered by a real layout engine, so text is exactly what you see. Pure AI-generated scenes may still get text wrong.
The interface switches between Chinese and English, and the conversation follows whatever language you use.

items.q: Can I use the images commercially?
items.a: Generated images are yours to use; make sure they comply with platform rules and the licenses of any reference material you upload.
